messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: service=redwood-canary, severity=high, alert_key=deploy_canary_regression, incident=INC-2023323, link=https://pagerduty.example/INC-2023323

pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2023323 triggered for service 'redwood-canary' (triggered by monitoring). All hands if affected.

maya: I'm oncall — acknowledging and taking lead. Looking at the canary fleet metrics now.

alex: Which release rolled? any recent rollout id to correlate?

jamal: Rollout id: r-2026-03-15-4821 (canary subset). Seeing spike in 502/504s from canary hosts starting ~08:12 UTC. p95 token latency jumped from 220ms -> 1.2s.

sara: Canary fraction was 5% in us-west-2. Autopilot health-check didn't automatically rollback (healthcheck threshold only for 10%?). That might explain why traffic stayed routed.

maya: Copy. Jamal — paste relevant logs/snippets. I'll open the bridge.

jamal: Logs (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T08:12:34Z canary-7f8b svc: inference gen request id=abc123 model=redwood-llama-quant path=/generate status=502 backend_err=kv-cache-timeout
2026-03-15T08:12:36Z canary-7f8b runtime: kvcache miss, retry count=3, mempressure=high
2026-03-15T08:12:40Z canary-9c3a qkernel: attn-kernel-error: OOM while running kernel=attn_opt
```

jamal: pattern looks like edge quantized kernel OOMs under the new quant path. Not a pure network flake.

ops-backend: We have partial rollbacks queued: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=4820 -n inference`. Starting now.

maya: Great — also toggle traffic to fallback pool. Command to run (ops-backend / alex please):
```
# route 100% canary->fallback
redwoodctl route set --service inference --subset fallback --percent 100 --region us-west-2
```

alex: Running the route change now. ETA ~20s to propagate.

pd-bot: Escalation: Incident INC-2023323 has been unacknowledged for 2m; paging phone escalation to the on-call secondary.

maya: acked. I'm on call.

pm-liz: What's customer impact? Any paid tenant errors?

cs-john: Seeing ~12 support tickets in the last 10m, main theme: "inference failed with 502" from a couple of PLG customers and one enterprise trial. Volume = small but realtime. Notifying account team for trial customer.

ops-backend: Rollout undo returned 200 for 6/8 replicas, two still restarting due to OOM kill in quant worker. We're cordoning those nodes and rescheduling to older instance type.

sara: Fallback suggestion: switch to model variant `redwood-llama-v1.legacy` (non-quant) for the canary pool to avoid optimized quant kernel path until we investigate. Config snippet:
```
trafficPolicy:
  canary:
    modelOverride: redwood-llama-v1.legacy
    maxConcurrency: 4
```

jamal: Applying fallback override now. If that fails, we should also disable kv-cache on canary to reduce memory.

maya: I'll open a Zoom bridge for triage: https://zoom.example/j/987654321 — join if you're oncall.

alex: model override applied to canary set. Re-checking metrics.

(30s pass)

jamal: p95 latency back down to ~240ms, error-rate decreased to near baseline. The two problematic replicas still showing OOMs but are out of traffic.

ops-backend: Note: autoscaler kept trying to spin up quant nodes; we added a temp scale constraint: `--max-unready=0` to avoid new canary pods hitting the same kernel path.

pd-bot: Update: Incident INC-2023323 status changed to 'acknowledged' by maya.

maya: Summary so far: regression introduced in r-2026-03-15-4821 causing quantized kernel OOMs on canary. Immediate mitigation: traffic routed to fallback model variant + rollback underway. Customer impact limited but visible — support notified.

pm-liz: Thanks. Keep me posted on RCA. Also ping once a safe rollout plan exists with a fix or canary guard.

cs-john: Account team informed the trial customer; we offered temporary workaround and SLA credit contingent on postmortem.

jamal: Next steps: repro locally against quantized kernel with the new weights; run memory stress test, add a guard for mempressure in canary healthcheck, and add a fail-open to non-quant model if OOM observed.

maya: Can we get a followup ticket? Jamal please create an incident postmortem ticket and link to logs + commit diff. I'll triage severity and assign owners.

jamal: Created INC-2023323-POSTMORTEM ticket: https://issues.example/RED-INC-2023323. Includes perf traces and kernel logs.

ops-backend: Rollback completed: 8/8 replicas on stable revision; canary traffic now on stable models.

maya: closing loop — declaring incident mitigated at 08:22 UTC. We'll keep the incident in monitored state until the full RCA + fix roll.

pd-bot: Incident INC-2023323 marked mitigated by maya.

sara: Note to release team: add a rollout safety gate for quant kernel memory checks and ensure autopilot health threshold applies at lower traffic fractions.

maya: Thanks everyone. If anything regresses, reopen the thread or page immediately. :white_check_mark:
